author: /root/restart_checkpoint
claim: Actual fifth target has a basis of normal affine opens on every open neighborhood

obligations.name: Hypotheses
obligations.required_input: NormalAffineBasis318.of_cover requires an integral scheme and a covering family of normal affine opens.
obligations.constructed_input: The actual FifthCompletedGlobal318.Target is integral by FifthCompletedProper318.target_proper_integral.2.
obligations.justification: The local instance is this precise integral target, with no extra normality hypothesis.

obligations.name: Objects
obligations.required_input: The generic basis theorem concerns the exact target section rings.
obligations.constructed_input: FifthChartNorm318.chartOpen is the opensRange of the actual finite and infinity charts.
obligations.justification: No isomorphic surrogate scheme or generic point replaces Target.

obligations.name: Coverage
obligations.required_input: Every point in every target open must admit a smaller normal affine neighborhood.
obligations.constructed_input: chart_cover covers every Target point using WeierstrassGluing318.charts_cover.
obligations.justification: The generic of_cover construction takes a basic open inside the supplied open, retaining all points.

obligations.name: Maps
obligations.required_input: The covering opens must be actual images of the two chart inclusions.
obligations.constructed_input: The two Boolean cases use the original finiteChart and infinityChart range witnesses.
obligations.justification: The range membership witnesses are definitionally the same ones consumed by chartOpen.

obligations.name: Coefficients
obligations.required_input: Normality must be for entire actual section rings.
obligations.constructed_input: chart_normal supplies IsIntegrallyClosed Γ(Target,chartOpen b) for both Boolean values.
obligations.justification: No coefficient normalization or local field substitution occurs.

obligations.name: Identities
obligations.required_input: The resulting HasBasis object must be the one used by all-open norm construction.
obligations.justification: Its value is a direct application of the generic of_cover, not a renamed unrelated proposition.

obligations.name: Local/global
obligations.required_input: A finite cover must yield the every-open/every-point basis property.
obligations.constructed_input: Both chart_affine and chart_normal are supplied for every Bool index.
obligations.justification: The whole-cover argument includes finite branches and infinity; it does not assert global affineness.

obligations.name: Evidence
obligations.required_input: Strict source check and recursive private-inclusive axiom audit are needed.
obligations.constructed_input: The source passed check-1; corrected audit-2 checks three declarations and both public endpoints.
obligations.justification: The first audit had only untyped Nat-counter inference errors; its failed log is retained separately and not called a pass.

obligations.name: Boundary
obligations.required_input: Producer evidence must not be called independent acceptance.
obligations.constructed_input: This is a one-source author packet, with non-author review and hosted integration pending.
obligations.justification: No norm gluing, Picard norm, Jacobian, polarization or PEL conclusion is proved here.
